# Create Venmo payment requests to roommates

receipt_content = receipt['content']
import re
m = re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', receipt_content)
print('total_amount_match', m.group(1) if m else None)

total_amount = float(m.group(1))
roommate_count = len(roommates)
people_count = roommate_count + 1  # roommates + me
share_amount = total_amount / people_count
print('total_amount', total_amount)
print('roommate_count', roommate_count)
print('people_count', people_count)
print('share_amount', share_amount)

created_request_ids=[]

for r in roommates:
    user_email = r['email']
    name = f"{r.get('first_name','')} {r.get('last_name','')}".strip()
    resp = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        user_email=user_email,
        amount=share_amount,
        description='I paid for cable bill.'
    )
    print('created_for', name, user_email, 'resp', resp)
    created_request_ids.append(resp.get('payment_request_id'))

print('created_request_ids', created_request_ids)

# Verification: fetch all sent payment requests and ensure the created ones exist
venmo_token = globals()['venmo_token']
created_request_ids = set([6097, 6098, 6099])

all_ids = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'page_count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    for item in page:
        all_ids.append(item.get('payment_request_id'))
    page_index += 1

found_ids = created_request_ids.intersection(set(all_ids))
print('created_request_ids', created_request_ids)
print('found_ids', found_ids)
print('missing_ids', created_request_ids - found_ids)
print('total_sent_payment_request_ids_seen', len(set(all_ids)))
